items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: We played out in Dallas and I met Alphonse (Adolphus?) Trent's band.

ctx.x: Who were some of the people that you met at that time?
... We played out in Dallas and I met Alphonse (Adolphus?) Trent's band. He had one of the best bands in Dallas.
